description: List the evaluation scenarios configured for this agent, each with its scenario text, categories, max_turns and success criteria. Their ids are what mba_start_eval_run takes.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_list_eval_cases

outputSchema.description: List of eval cases for the entity

categories.description: Category strings for the test scenario

max_turns.description: Maximum number of turns allowed in the conversation simulation

scenario.description: Free-form text defining the task and constraints for the user simulator

success_criteria.description: Criteria strings the agent must meet for the test to pass

title: List evaluation cases
